variants.title: Boltzmann constant from a junction, read with an Arduino ADC
variants.sample: Diode-connected BC547 read by an Arduino Uno
variants.note: Both voltages are read by the Arduino's 10-bit converter on its internal 1.1 V reference, so each reading is rounded down to a whole step of 1.07 mV; the current is the voltage across the 1 kohm resistor divided by 1 kohm.

source.title: ATmega328P data sheet: 10-bit ADC with a 1.1 V internal reference
source.note: From memory - verify (the reference is specified to about +-10 %; this lab takes it as exactly 1.1 V)
